title: Settings (M6)
brief: Settings screen of goop (/settings): full screen with two panes, a short category list on the left (Search preferences, Schedule, Appearance, Keys, Privacy & data opens M13, About) and the fields of Search preferences on the right as terminal form rows (role keywords, seniority and work mode as inline radios, locations, minimum salary, languages, show offers from score). The focused field takes the selection style and in edit state shows a lavender composer input; dim notes say what goop does with each field. The selected row carries its own muted action at the right (↵ edit, or ↵ done · esc cancel while editing) and the category pane has no key hints of its own. Form actions live in the single status line while there are unsaved changes (● 1 unsaved · ctrl+s save in green · ctrl+z undo · ctrl+d discard, then tab and esc); no second bar. Settings are stored encrypted on this machine and never sent anywhere. Breadcrumb Settings › Search preferences · 6 categories · esc back to session 3; pane heads Categories and Fields (7 · used by the next search). Status line with the settings focus mode and ○ next search 09:00 │ ? help. Below the screen: the save toast with ctrl+z undo, the Schedule category preview, a full-width Appearance category preview with the Icons form row (value emoji, the default; muted note nerd · emoji · letters · emoji works on most terminals; nerd needs a Nerd Font) and the one-line ask when leaving with unsaved changes (Save 1 change? y yes · n no · esc stay; --background-panel, 2px --accent edge, keys bold --text).

artboards.title: Full screen
artboards.tradeoff: Two panes with plain label/value form rows, edit in place through a lavender composer and an explicit save (save keys in the status line only while unsaved, ask on leave); hides the chat and edits long values one line at a time
